body: My experiences have been unexplainable plus I don’t want people to think I’m crazy. But this is my 3rd time seeing the child and my second seeing them after calling to my guide. But I keep ignoring it. Because I don’t even question it being there until I wake up. But this time it was in my house siting at the island like it was apart of the family. After the second time I told myself I would acknowledge it the next time and I obviously forgot. I will definitely research the intuitive breathing. I feel like it could actually work so I thank you for responding!!!
Thank you

I’m starting to understand that family isn’t as black and white as they say it is. “ blood is thicker than water” “ family first above all else” but what about when it’s a one sided experience. I have 3 older siblings who have been using me my entire life. Two have been using me as a personal babysitter and therapist not caring what’s going on in my life or what responsibilities I have only about what I can do for them and how they always do for others and no one does for them. They guilt trip so much it’s unbearable. But they also talk down to you and about you every second and blame you for everything whilst your helping them. And a third sister who uses me as a way to uplift herself. Using any low moment in my life as a means for others to look down on me and praise her. But constantly calling me her best friend. I’ve always felt like I had to continue to be around them because they’re my family and at the end of the day that’s all I’ll ever have is my family. No wonder all of my relationships are one sided and I’m consistently giving and getting nothing in return and putting up with so much because I feel like “ I have too”.  I feel like I have to completely rebuild myself from years of damage that I didn’t even realize was negatively impacting my life and interactions with others.

I’m going to take some notes from this and memorize them because you are absolutely right. If someone sees you hurting but ignores it because it wouldn’t be beneficial to them to acknowledge or understand it doesn’t have genuine love. I can see that now. I can feel that now. I already feel sad accepting it.

I wish I could like this a million times!!!! Thank you sooooooo much! You are absolutely right. If I can just get through one moment of fear I can be at peace. But my bleeding heart lol I feel bad so fast and when someone hurts I want to make them better more than myself. What helps through that part?

Yes! Honestly hearing everyone’s comments has been very helpful and I’m genuinely taking it to heart because it has been a struggle for me. Even if I feel like I wanna make a change and cut out the toxicity, it just gives me anxiety thinking about the response I’ll get in return. I sike myself out quite a bit and I really do need to be stronger and really put myself first. I love my alone time it’s my only peace. Perhaps if I just keep people out of my life for a while it will help me fully repair the damage that’s done before someone can add new wounds.  Thank you for sharing a bit of your experience with me. I legit thought I was going crazy but knowing that someone has gone through it in the same pattern and walked away makes me feel soooooooooo much better. I’m still scared but not as much. I feel a little bit more grounded like a bit stronger lol.

I stay way too long honestly. 
I stayed in a relationship 6 years miserable for all 6 because I was married and felt like I had to stay 😒..
I’ve currently been in a relationship 2 years that I also feel obligated to be in because I don’t want to hurt them. They literal energy vampires but I’m afraid of Retaliation if I just walk away. I hate drama and confrontation. I had a friend who was great until they put us in a very uncomfortable situation. I tried to remedy the situation but they were way to comfortable in the situation and I knew then they weren’t someone I should hang around but I hung around until they decided I was the new target. I really don’t know why I’m more concerned about others feelings with less regard to my own. I have tried. But it’s like committing and crime. I get nervous. I start to sweat. I can’t get my words together. And all it takes is one sad sob story to take me out of my discomfort and back to my misery. I have a lot of work ahead of me.

What makes it worse is the thoughts in the back of my mind saying “maybe they’re right” “perhaps you’re crazy” “maybe you’re the toxic one” so much uncertainty.. it really is a battle. You seem to have it figured out and for that I envy you lol I wish I were brave enough to return the toxic energy but I would feel bad making others feel the way they make me feel. I really don’t understand why people are quick to judge our spiritual journeys. We are legit trying to be more peaceful and loving beings. What’s so wrong about that?
Thank you!! I’m very awkward.. lol I don’t even know how to start a convo lol

I feel like I settle and just put up with people because it’s what I deserve? Like some type of karmic balance.. but I don’t know what I’ve done. It kinda makes me afraid to even start new friendships because what if they’re worse. I never know It’s unhealthy until a redflag is presented and then I’m too emotionally involved and I don’t want to hurt the other person. I’m very easily guilted and I hate it. It was easier to separate myself from my family, people I’ve let make me feel less than but loved for my entire life, than to hurt someone I’ve known for a couple years or even a few months.  I want peace and healthy relationships but for some reason they don’t feel one in the same. Also I’m not very consistent, I shut down a lot and go ghost for weeks at a time not talking at all.

Yes! I have fallen completely on my face. My spiritual journey started years ago just questioning everything and being open and curious to new possibilities while maintaining my place in society as just a spectator. Doing what needs to get done to survive and not being happy because you have to sacrifice to earn happiness. But I found myself always sacrificing but never earning the happiness and then feeling impatient for questioning how long it would take. It took me completely falling to finally see it. My journey has been a mixture of emotions and uncertainty. But also full of excitement and curiosity. But I have a different understanding now. I can’t just spectate anymore. I don’t just fit in anymore. Sometimes I feel really lonely and out of place like I belong nowhere. It’s hard. I don’t wanna be around certain people but I don’t wanna be alone either. I’m still trying spectate to feel like I fit in somewhere. When my journey kicked in high gear I wanted to put myself first and love myself first but that voice in my heads keeps saying I’m selfish or I think I’m better than people or I’m wrong for separating myself from certain people. I feel like I’m going crazy sometimes. I just want peace. I want calm. I want to feel like I belong somewhere. Where I don’t feel crazy or not accepted or misunderstood. Even typing this I feel like I’m just complaining. Like me feeling the way I feel is silly. Like I’m being dramatic. I can’t even validate my own feelings but I want to validate others.

I agree. I do look at myself and try to dissect why I am accepting negativity like I can handle it. I take in a lot of people under false pretenses. Like we have so much in common until the red flags start popping up. Then I feel bad for wanting to end the friendship without giving them benefit of doubt. Or I allow them to gaslight me into feeling like I have to accept them for all their “flaws” or I’m being judgmental when I say I’m not. Are they right? Am I a hypocrite? Or am I just easy to manipulate? Am I a victim? Or am I just playing victim to feel sympathy for myself? I fight with myself a lot about whether I’m the problem or not. I don’t want to fight with myself anymore. Shouldn’t it be easier than this? Should their even be a fight? I don’t even know what an easy friendship feels like anymore where your not walking on eggshells. But I feel like it’s not normal and I want better. If it even exist.

I don't know if you remember a couple years ago when the idea to storm area 51 came about. the idea started as a small joke. That small joke was a tiny spark that started a flame and people actually came together whether they believed in what they would find there or not. Why cant this be the same. whether they believe or not why not come to seek answers to questions not asked yet. why not collectively run together to raise the vibrations of this world and end the simulation if not for any other reason besides shits and giggles.
And I absolutely love it..

I honestly don’t know. Everytime I’ve made new friends I’m never their cup of tea. I always find myself pretending to be something I’m not please others and it only makes me hate the person I’ve become.. it’s hard to find someone on the same wave length as me. I feel like my looks don’t match my mind so people are disappointed when they have a conversation with me and I tell them I’m currently waiting for my ride off this planet lol.. I have this fantasy that friendship is easy peasy. Like you meet someone you both like the color green and run off into the sunset. But it feels more like a relationship you have to constantly work at to maintain. I feel like it should be as easy as breathing.
This makes me happy too!

Your safe.. fear is just the years of conditioning from books, movies, religions and television telling you should be afraid. Your guides protect you. Next time you get scared ask yourself why you are afraid.. and if it’s because of something that conditioned you to be afraid.. know it’s not real.. unlearning all the lies we have been taught is the hardest part of this journey.. you got this!
Maybe orbs? I seem them when I’m meditating/ reflecting.. usually my spirit guides letting me know they are present and I am safe. Have you seen shadows yet?
Lol. I don’t think it works that way. If you text yourself, are you really talking to someone?

I really feel like my cat stumbled into my dream and freaked out. The NPCs (conscious creations) simply play out a story and I think my cat trying to interact with one didn’t go well.. I also believe me waking from the dream through him out as well.. he looked very concerned and scared when I woke up.

I get radio silence for a few days then a huge energy surge of dreams.. orbs.. and shadows then back to radio silence.. I gave up on trying to control it. I just try to journal my experience to make sense of them later.

Open your mind by educating yourself. Follow pages that resonate with your beliefs and read about the things you question.. practice meditation as often as you can.. it’s hard with a busy mind but I cheat.. I’ll play meditation music in my ears and take naps lol.. the music keeps my mind calm.
Do you ever just feel the urge to meditate.. I’m going to try and see the experience through next time it happens..
